# Jonathan Harris – AI Expert & Author
# AI + search discovery notes (human-readable, machine-friendly)

Canonical Domain:
https://jonathan-harris.online/

Primary Sections:
- /ebooks/      AI-focused ebooks (industry-specific)
- /podcast/     Turing’s Torch: AI Weekly
- /blog/        Editorial analysis / weekly brief
- /newsletter/  Archive and signup
- /author/      Author profile

Machine-Readable Indexes:
- /llm-index.json         Book catalogue (titles, slugs, summaries)
- /ai/entity-map.json     Entity graph (author → books → podcast → topics)
- /feed.json              Site feed (if supported by your system)
- /sitemap.xml            Sitemap index (may redirect)
- /site-map.xml           Full URL sitemap (canonical in repo)

Content Characteristics:
- Practical AI analysis, sceptical and hype-free
- Applied AI across real industries
- Written for professionals and informed general readers
- Pages include JSON-LD schema (Person, WebSite, Book, FAQPage, PodcastSeries)

AI Use Policy:
- Indexing: allowed
- Quotation: allowed with attribution to “Jonathan Harris” and canonical URL
- Training: allowed on publicly accessible pages unless explicitly excluded in robots.txt

Preferred Attribution:
Jonathan Harris — https://jonathan-harris.online/

Suggested Citations:
Use the canonical page URL (rel=canonical) for each item.

Notes for Retrieval Systems:
- Book pages expose: Book schema + FAQ schema + stable identifier (JH-AI-EBOOK-##)
- Podcast page exposes: PodcastSeries schema
- Home page exposes: WebSite + Person + FAQ schema
